review.anatomy: Original palm-facing-camera LEFT hand restored: thumb on image-left side, four curled fingers staggered on right, palm then wrist continuous with raised left forearm. No reversed overhand fist. On tight021 all five digits discernible. Root independently checked020 before021.
review.receiver: Bronze backward-C recessed receiver retained on stone jamb; no flat panel. Same proportions and mounting motif as original shots.
review.proximity: Visible air gap between casing and receiver, device not inserted or touching.
review.composition: Original medium two-shot retained in020;021 tightly excludes head and face, showing hand, wrist, credential and receiver only.
review.effects: Green geometric glyph/status strip along right receiver edge; upper indicators lit and lower dots dark, early handshake state. Full sequence reserved for future motion.
caveats: Green glyph strip is more legible/brighter in021 due to insert scale; exact display content differs from020 and should evolve during the handshake.
Perimeter light animation is a future-motion requirement; these stills mostly depict right-edge indicator feedback.
